faq.title: A few good questions.

free.question: Can I really start for free?
free.answer: Yes. Try video transcription and automatic answers within the free plan’s allowance, with no credit card required. See the pricing page for usage limits and paid plans.

accounts.question: Do students need an account?
accounts.answer: Not with a course link. Anyone with the link can view and ask questions without signing in. To limit access, use member invitations.

cost.question: Who pays for automatic answers?
cost.answer: Automatic answers count against the course owner’s allowance. Students pay nothing.

accuracy.question: Can it give wrong answers?
accuracy.answer: Answers are based on your lectures and show the source moment. AI-generated answers and transcripts can still contain mistakes, so students can always check the original explanation in context.

history.question: Can I see what students asked?
history.answer: Yes. You can review and export the course’s question and answer history. For invited members, usernames and email addresses are also shown.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.body: These terms govern VideoQ (https://videoq.jp), an AI video learning service. Creating an account or using the service means you accept these terms.

account.title: 2. Accounts
account.body: You must register with accurate information and keep your credentials secure. Accounts are not transferable. We may suspend an account for abuse or a breach of these terms.

plans.title: 3. Plans and quotas
plans.body: The Service offers Free, Basic and Pro plans. Monthly transcription allowances are 45 minutes for Free, 200 for Basic and 1,000 for Pro. Storage, AI answers, monthly uploads and other entitlements are shown on the pricing page. Free is a no-cost trial allowance. Changes to allowances or downgrades do not delete existing videos, chats or recorded usage. Additional uploads, transcription or AI answers may be restricted when usage exceeds the new limit. Monthly usage resets on the first day of each month in UTC.

payment.title: 4. Fees and payment
payment.body: New subscriptions from the English site are billed in US dollars; the Japanese site uses Japanese yen. Prices include applicable tax. Existing subscriptions keep their billing currency. Stripe processes payments. VideoQ does not store card numbers. Monthly plans renew every month and yearly plans every year on the saved payment method. Mid-cycle plan changes follow the Customer Portal proration setting (immediate invoice).

cancel.title: 5. Cancellation
cancel.body: You can cancel from Settings or the Stripe Customer Portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You keep paid-plan quotas until then. Unused time is not refunded except as described in the refund policy.

acceptableUse.title: 6. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You may not break the law, infringe others’ rights, disrupt the service, attempt unauthorized access, send abusive automated traffic, or otherwise misuse the service. You must have the rights needed for the videos and questions you submit.

data.title: 7. Data
data.body: Rights in videos and text you submit remain with you or their original owners. You must have the rights needed to submit them. You grant us a non-exclusive permission, limited to providing the service, to store, convert, transcribe, index, use them to generate AI answers, and display them to people you authorize. This processing includes the service providers described in our Privacy Policy. That policy explains how we handle videos, transcripts, chat history, and other personal data. Stripe also processes payment data.

liability.title: 8. Liability
liability.body: The service is provided as is. We do not warrant that transcriptions or AI answers are accurate. Except for liability that cannot be excluded by law, our damages are limited to the fees you paid in the previous three months.

changes.title: 9. Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be posted on the service or sent to your registered email. Continued use after a change means you accept it.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms: yukiharada1228@gmail.com. Seller details are listed on the Specified Commercial Transactions notice.

controller.title: 1. Controller
controller.body: Yuki Harada, the operator of VideoQ (https://videoq.jp), handles personal data collected through the service under this policy. Contact: yukiharada1228@gmail.com.

collect.title: 2. Data we collect
collect.body: We collect account details (email, display name, username), authentication and connected-service information, uploaded videos and metadata, YouTube video IDs, transcripts, questions, answers and chat history, usage totals, technical data about your browser or device, and billing details needed for payment. We also store SearchAPI API keys you choose to provide in encrypted form. Card numbers are processed by Stripe and are not stored on VideoQ servers.

stripe.title: 3. Sharing with Stripe
stripe.body: To charge paid plans, manage subscriptions, and prevent fraud, we share name, email, billing address, customer IDs, and plan information with Stripe. See https://stripe.com/privacy for how Stripe uses that data.

purpose.title: 4. Purpose
purpose.body: We use this data for account authentication, video storage and delivery, caption retrieval and transcription, search indexing and AI answers, quota management, billing, invitation and verification emails, fraud prevention, support, usage measurement, service improvement, and legal compliance. We do not use it for unrelated purposes without consent.

share.title: 5. External services and sharing
share.body:
We do not sell personal data. We use the following external services as needed to provide VideoQ.
• Cloudflare: app delivery, API execution, and storage of videos and images. Neon: database storage of accounts, transcripts, chat history, and other records. AWS: processing queues and video processing.
• OpenRouter and the providers that perform inference (such as OpenAI, DeepInfra and Groq): Segmented audio extracted from uploaded videos is sent through OpenRouter to the Whisper Large V3 Turbo transcription model, which returns a transcript. The complete video, account email address and chat history are not sent for this transcription. These providers also process embeddings of captions and search queries; answers based on questions, relevant captions, and course information; and, when needed, analysis of still frames extracted from videos. Our answer generation does not send the entire chat history.
• SearchAPI: YouTube video IDs and related parameters for caption retrieval. Google: authentication if you choose Google sign-in. Mailgun: recipient address, subject, and body for verification, invitation, and other service emails. Stripe's handling of payment data is described in section 3.
These providers may process or route data outside Japan, including in the United States. Apart from disclosures required by law, we limit what we share to the data needed for each operation.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.body: We retain videos, transcripts and chat history while an account is active for as long as needed to provide the Service. After account deletion, data controlled by VideoQ is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, except where retention is required by law. Data sent to external services is subject to each provider’s retention policy. AI inputs and outputs pass through OpenRouter and the provider performing inference; logging, retention periods and conditions for training use vary by provider and settings. See https://openrouter.ai/privacy and https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/provider-logging. Data sent to external providers before a routing change may remain subject to the policies that applied when it was sent. Payment records held by Stripe follow Stripe’s retention policy.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, suspension, or deletion of your personal data by emailing yukiharada1228@gmail.com. We will verify your identity and respond as required by law.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies to keep you signed in and protect the service, and browser local storage to remember your display language. To measure landing-page actions and referral sources, we use browser session storage and send limited event data to Cloudflare logs. These events do not contain questions, videos, or email addresses. This measurement is disabled when Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control is enabled in your browser. Blocking cookies may stop some features from working.

summary.title: Overview
summary.body: Paid VideoQ plans are a digital SaaS. There are no physical returns. Cancellation and refunds work as follows.

digital.title: Digital service
digital.body: After payment succeeds we immediately apply paid-plan quotas to your account. Service delivery starts when payment completes.

cancel.title: Cancellation
cancel.body: Cancel anytime from Settings or the Stripe Customer Portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You keep paid access until then, then return to Free. Unused time in the current period is not refunded by default.

upgrade.title: Plan changes

howto.title: If you want a refund
howto.body: For duplicate charges, payment errors, or cases where the law requires a refund, email yukiharada1228@gmail.com with the account and what happened. We will review it. For card chargebacks, contact us first.
